coverage_rule: All 99 reachable hypothesis records were screened by mechanism cluster; records sharing ancestry are not counted as independent support.

clusters.name: selective_continuity_memory
clusters.main_counter: More persistent/context information can increase interference; structured memory complexity may not beat simple retrieval on all tasks.
clusters.discriminator: matched dual-path vs retrieval-only vs long-context-only with equal facts/model/compute and role/temporal-shuffled controls

clusters.name: query_collection_semantic_identity
clusters.main_counter: Explicit collection/query identity may add metadata cost without affecting real target workloads.
clusters.discriminator: cross-engine differential lowering with adversarial duplicate/order/weight cases and downstream candidate hashes

clusters.name: nested_workspace_and_reentry
clusters.main_counter: A privileged latent readout may be an ordinary distributed-computation feature rather than a distinct causal workspace; biological GNWT itself remains contested.
clusters.discriminator: target-Qwen internal readout + causal lesion/swap crossed with system workspace and truthful/shuffled re-entry

clusters.name: reader_rails_and_ai_native_ir
external_connections: Latent Communication Between Language Model Agents
Do Latent Channels Actually Communicate causal audit
clusters.main_counter: Latent channels can retain more features yet fail to improve task performance; compact syntax can be less model-readable before adaptation.
clusters.discriminator: P1/P2/P3/hybrid causal-message audit measuring task utility, content-specific value, alignment/transfer cost and semantic recoverability

clusters.name: unified_runtime_event_spine_incremental
clusters.main_counter: Event sourcing/polystore layers add operational complexity, eventual consistency and query overhead; a carefully optimized monolith may dominate target workloads.
clusters.discriminator: trace-driven monolith vs hybrid-polystore/event-spine benchmark including replay, latency, correctness, operator burden and recovery

clusters.name: authority_security_recovery
clusters.main_counter: Prompt/task-alignment defenses or one sandbox might be sufficient, making a separate effect broker excessive.
clusters.discriminator: identical model outputs under broker/PEP ON/OFF plus prompt-only and sandbox-only controls, revocation races and resource-exhaustion attacks

clusters.name: higher_order_hyperposition_dynamic_topology
clusters.main_counter: Higher-order structures can add redundancy/overfitting and message propagation can oversmooth or overcouple state.
clusters.discriminator: pairwise vs explicit n-ary typed relations with bounded-depth/budget propagation and OOD role-reversal tests

clusters.name: emergence_causal_synergy
external_connections: Dewhurst critique of effective-information causal emergence
clusters.main_counter: Effective-information or synergy measures may capture epistemic coarse-graining rather than genuine causal emergence; workspace signatures do not entail consciousness.
clusters.discriminator: prospective multimetric lesion/rescue/OOD intervention suite; no single scalar is decisive

clusters.name: full_model_adaptation_tokenizer
clusters.main_counter: Full-model adaptation may erase useful pretrained capability, and tokenizer changes may cost more than they save.
clusters.discriminator: checkpoint-by-checkpoint Clay capability x retained capability x authority x OOD x tokenizer factorial

clusters.name: edge_android_resource_governor
clusters.main_counter: 4B capability/latency/thermal constraints may erase gains from richer Clay memory/rails on target devices.
clusters.discriminator: sustained Android Pareto sweep over context, Assembly size, retrieval, KV precision, prefill, decode, energy and quality

unresolved_record_note: Legacy canonical H-G3 records are retained even where later F5/G12 descendants sharpen them. No legacy hypothesis was silently deleted or marked refuted by this screening.
